==The Wood that Won the War==
[[File:3806.png|thumb|291px]]Hex 38.06

Connects to: 08.16, 24.11 and 39.08.01.

The stump of the bush of the dryad who ended the [[Seelie-Unseelie wars]] lies in the middle of this grove. (See [[hawthorn]] for more.)
